Subject: Duplicate ACH debit on invoice #INV-2026-07-48 + VAT support requested

Hi Jasmine,

We noticed a duplicate ACH debit from Redwood on 2026-08-06 for $18,742.50 referencing invoice INV-2026-07-48. Our bank shows two identical debits with transaction IDs ending in ...674 and ...874. We only authorized one payment; the second went out in error on your end.

Can you confirm you received this and advise how Redwood will reverse the duplicate or process a refund? In addition, we need an invoice that includes our EU VAT registration so we can reclaim VAT on the charge.

I've attached a screenshot from our online banking showing both debits. If you need a stamped bank statement, I can provide that as well.

Thanks — we need this resolved before we close our month.

Regards,

Hi Liam, Jasmine — thanks, I see the payment activity in AR and there's indeed a duplicate settlement for INV-2026-07-48. Planned approach below: 

1) Verification: we need either (a) a stamped/official bank statement showing both debits, or (b) a PDF of the account activity with the full transaction reference and your account last 4 digits. That will be enough to start a reversal.

2) Refund vs reversal: our usual process is to attempt an ACH reversal if the duplicate is within our bank's reversal window; otherwise we'll issue a refund to the same account. Both methods take 2 business days to show on the customer's side after processing.

3) Accounting docs: we'll issue a credit memo (CM-2026-082) to offset the duplicate charge and reissue a corrected invoice that includes your VAT number (INV-2026-07-48A). Please provide your EU VAT registration number exactly as it appears on your certificate.

4) Required forms: I'm attaching our refund memo template and VAT request form — please complete and return. The accounting ticket is AR-2026-4437; I'll update it with the uploaded docs.

Estimated timeline: once we receive the bank statement and VAT number, we will: verify within 1 business day, process reversal/refund within 1 additional business day, and post the credit memo + corrected invoice the same day.

Attachments (for your convenience): refund-memo-template.docx; vat-request-form.pdf
Related: HubSpot deal HS-Deal-88421; DocuSign auth: https://docusign.com/records/REDW-ACH-AUTH-5567

Please confirm you'll send the statement and VAT reg. If you'd prefer, we can process a refund immediately and handle VAT reissuance separately — let me know which you prefer.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
